en.name: Liquid Glass Effect
en.title: Liquid Glass Effect: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: Glass lenses pop onto a phone UI's tab bar, caret, toggle and scrubber, refracting what is below. Make it with Claude Code or Codex from the free recipe.
howto: Build each lens as a scaled copy of the same content clipped to a pill, with saturate(1.2) contrast(1.03): tab bar 72 x 56 px at 1.55x, caret loupe 132 x 58 at 1.7x, toggle 64 x 40 at 1.5x. Pop each lens in over 0.28 s with expo.out from scale 0.7 to 0.85 up to 1.0 to 1.12. Controls stay solid at rest and turn to glass only while dragged.

Give the glass a white top highlight, a 1.2 px conic-gradient rim (pink, amber, green, blue, violet) and 3 px pink and blue inner edge shadows. The lens and its content copy move in the same tween with the same ease and duration, 0.7 s on the tab bar and 1.1 s on the scrubber. The camera pushes the scaled stage to 1.75, 2.3, 2.9 and finally 6.0 into the knob.

Press the copy button on the recipe page and paste it into Claude Code or Codex, or run npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent renders an MP4 with HyperFrames, or ports the GSAP timeline to your site with your own interface.
faq: What is the liquid glass effect?

It is a translucent material that refracts and magnifies the content behind it, with a bright edge and color dispersion at the rim, so a control looks like a piece of curved glass sitting on the interface.
Can I make a liquid glass effect in CSS?

Partly. backdrop-filter gives blur and saturation, and an SVG displacement filter can bend the backdrop in Chromium browsers. This recipe uses a more portable method: a scaled copy of the content clipped to a pill, moved in the same tween, which also renders to video.
Is the Liquid Glass Effect recipe free to use?

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

zh.name: 液态玻璃效果
zh.title: 液态玻璃效果：示例与制作配方
zh.description: 玻璃透镜依次出现在手机界面的标签栏、光标、开关和进度条上，折射放大下方内容。用免费配方，让 Claude Code 或 Codex 做出液态玻璃效果。
howto: 每个透镜都是同一份内容的放大副本，裁成胶囊形，加 saturate(1.2) contrast(1.03)：标签栏 72 x 56px 放大 1.55 倍，光标放大镜 132 x 58 放大 1.7 倍，开关 64 x 40 放大 1.5 倍。透镜用 expo.out 在 0.28 秒内从 0.7 到 0.85 的缩放弹到 1.0 到 1.12。控件静止时是实体，只在被拖动时变成玻璃。
玻璃带白色顶部高光、1.2px 的锥形渐变边缘（粉、琥珀、绿、蓝、紫），以及 3px 的粉色和蓝色内边缘阴影。透镜和它下面的内容副本放在同一个动画里，缓动和时长一致，标签栏 0.7 秒，进度条 1.1 秒。镜头推动放大的舞台，依次到 1.75、2.3、2.9 倍，最后以 6.0 倍推进旋钮。
在配方页点复制按钮，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以运行 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装技能。智能体会用 HyperFrames 渲染 MP4，或者把 GSAP 时间线移植到你的网站，界面换成你自己的。
faq: 指一种半透明材质：折射并放大背后的内容，边缘明亮并带色散，让控件看起来像放在界面上的一块弧面玻璃。
能用 CSS 做液态玻璃效果吗？
可以做一部分。backdrop-filter 提供模糊和饱和度，SVG 位移滤镜在 Chromium 浏览器里能弯折背景。这份配方用的是兼容性更好的做法：把内容的放大副本裁成胶囊，和玻璃在同一个动画里移动，也能直接渲染成视频。
液态玻璃效果配方可以免费使用吗？
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
